_doc: Manual slug/path renames. Rows with redirect_status=final in the Airtable 301 REDIRECTS table are synced here by tools/sync_redirects_from_snapshot.py. from: old path (no trailing slash). to: canonical target (trailing slash on index/detail routes). Consumed by: client SPA guard, generate-route-redirects.mjs (static HTML), seo-worker (301).
